approved: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
This bill would authorise spending from the Consolidated Revenue Fund for government services that are not part of the ordinary annual services.
It is one of three Additional Estimates Bills that together provide extra funding for decisions made after the 2023-24 Budget.
The bill does not specify the amount of money to be appropriated or the programs it funds.
The bill would appropriate money from the Consolidated Revenue Fund.
It would fund government services that are not the ordinary annual services.
It would be read with the Portfolio Additional Estimates Statements and the earlier Budget Bills.
The Australian Government and its agencies that receive the additional appropriations.
